title: Renew a professional engineer registration
summary: Learn how to renew your professional engineer registration online before it expires.
intro:
When your professional engineer registration is nearing its expiry date you'll receive a renewal notice. You can then renew your registration online before the due date.

### If your registration has expired

You cannot make declarations or lodge regulated designs as a professional engineer in NSW if your registration has expired.

### Change of name or contact details

If you have changed your name or contact details do not start your application until you complete the Building Commission NSW form Change of Details – PDF.

### Check your registration details

To check your registration number and details visit Verify NSW.
who_can_apply: Complete 50 hours each year of relevant continuing professional development (CPD).
Hold the required level of insurance cover.
what_you_need: Your renewal number (as shown on your renewal notice).
Evidence of your continuing professional development.

how_to_steps.text: Gather the required documents including evidence of your continuing professional development.
Log in to your MyServiceNSW Account.
Follow the prompts to renew your registration.

faqs.q: What happens if my professional engineer registration has expired?
faqs.a: If your registration has expired, you cannot make declarations or lodge regulated designs as a professional engineer in NSW.

faqs.q: Do I need to update my name or contact details before applying?
faqs.a: Yes, if you have changed your name or contact details, you must complete the Building Commission NSW form Change of Details – PDF before starting your application.

faqs.q: How can I check my current registration details?
faqs.a: You can check your registration number and details by visiting Verify NSW.
